tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search approved products on the Digital Underground Developer Marketplace (apps, AI tools, books, templates by independent makers). Returns summaries with links. Checkout happens on each maker's own site.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get full public details (including the long description) of one approved listing by its id (cm_...).

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit the user's own product to the marketplace. Requires the creator's API key (duk_..., from the Creator dashboard -> API keys; never guess one). Free. tools.name: get_my_listing_status
tools.description: Check the review status (pending, approved, rejected) of one of the user's own listings. Requires their API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_listing_status · Private data: submit_listing, get_my_listing_status · Public sink: submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_listing_status · Private data: submit_listing, get_my_listing_status · Public sink: submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
